callSites.currentTaskState: null before Task creation; otherwise any non-terminal state from accepted through verifying
callSites.trustedRunIdSource: For executeWithRun failures, identity.runId is available inside executeWithRun before TaskStore.failRunVerification clears activeRunId; current generic catch receives no explicit identity. For failures outside a Run, null.
callSites.failureStage: runtime_internal today; provider_execution or verification can be determined only if executeWithRun attaches Runtime-owned context before rethrow
callSites.defaultErrorCode: RUNTIME_INTERNAL_FAILED today; proposed Runtime enums PROVIDER_EXECUTION_FAILED / VERIFICATION_FAILED / RUNTIME_INTERNAL_FAILED
callSites.failureClassification: runtime_failure today; proposed provider_failure / verification_failure / runtime_failure
callSites.taskRevisionSource: The authoritative value must be the revision produced by the TaskStore.patch that successfully persists Task.failure after the Task has transitioned to failed.
callSites.failedAtSource: AgentRuntime trusted clock (options.now or Date.now), captured once during first failure persistence

runFacts.activeRunIdClearedAt: channels/task-store.mjs:59 failRunVerification saves activeRunId=null after locating the active Run from the supplied trusted identity
runFacts.requiredPreservation: executeWithRun must retain its local identity and attach a Runtime-owned failure context before rethrow; failTask must not attempt to rediscover runId from activeRunId after it is cleared.

taskRevisionRules.patch: TaskStore.patch increments taskRevision only when activeRunId is null; otherwise revision is unchanged.
taskRevisionRules.transitionTask: transitionTask increments taskRevision only when activeRunId is null; otherwise revision is unchanged.
taskRevisionRules.approvedFailureMeaning: Transition the Task to failed, then persist Task.failure with taskRevision equal to the revision produced by that failure patch.

taskStoreSupport.reason: TaskStore.patch already accepts an arbitrary failure object and persists it atomically; failure is not a protected field.

causeCodePolicy: Optional. Accept only a string matching a bounded identifier pattern and maximum length; never use it to derive stage, classification, authorization, risk or provider selection.
